lead: Two `catch` arms in one file may not reuse the binding name.
body: A hostile case is several numbered `try` steps in one program, so a second `} catch (LogicError $caught) {` is `E0406: $caught is already declared` pointing at the first arm, because a catch binding is an ordinary file-scope local and not scoped to its arm. Name each arm for what it caught — `$byZero`, `$repeats`, `$tooWide` — which reads better in the `echo` beside it anyway.
